presets.name: Classic phaser
presets.description: Two notches on a slow triangle, the four-stage pedal sound.

presets.name: Deep phaser
presets.description: Six notches with feedback, slow and wide, for pads.

presets.name: Funky phaser
presets.description: A quicker, resonant sweep for rhythm parts.

presets.name: Bar phaser
presets.description: One sweep a bar, locked to the song.

presets.name: Spinning phaser
presets.description: The sides sweeping at different speeds, drifting in and out of step.

presets.name: Touch phaser
presets.description: Notches that open with how hard you play.

presets.name: Classic flanger
presets.description: A slow, sweeping flanger with some feedback.

presets.name: Jet flanger
presets.description: The jet-plane whoosh: a slow, deep sweep with high feedback.

presets.name: Tape flange
presets.description: Through Zero with the feedback inverted: the deep, cancelling sweep of two tapes.

presets.name: Metallic flanger
presets.description: Short, fast and resonant: a ringing, robotic edge.

presets.name: Touch flanger
presets.description: A flanger that sweeps with each hit.

presets.name: Wide doubler
presets.description: Two takes, one on each side, for a fuller voice.
